div.l: That fro the tyme he first began
To ride oute he loued chiualry
Treuth honoure fredom and cortasy
Ful worthi he was in his lordez werre
And there to had he ridden̄ no man ferre
As well in cristendome as in hethinesse
And euer honoured for his worthinesse
At Alisaundre he was whan it was won̄
Ful oft he hadde the borde begon̄
A boue all nacions in prude
In letawe hadde raised and in ruse
No cristen man so oft in his degre
In Garnard atte sege eke had he be
Of Algazir and riden̄ in belmary
At lyeus was he and at Sataly
Whan þei were wonnen and on þe grete see
At mani a noble aryue hadde he be
At mortall bataile hadde he be xvⁿᵉ
And foughten for oure feith Atte Tramyssene
In listes iij and ay slayn his foo
This same knight hadde be also
Som tyme with þe lorde of palacy
Ayenst anoþer hethen in Turky
And euer more hadde a soueraigne price
And thought that he was worthi for he was wise
And of his porte meke as a maide
He never yit no vilany seid
In all his life to no maner wight
He was a gentil ꝑparfite knight
Fore to tel you of his aray
His horse was goode but he was not gay
Of fustian he wered a Gippoıı̄un
All be smotherd with his haberyoıı̄un
Fore he was late Icme fro his viage
And went for to haue done his pilgrimage
With him þere was his son a yong squier
A louer and a lusti bachiller
With lokkes crull as þei were leid in presse
Of xx yere of age he was I gesse
Of his stature he was of euen length
And wonderli deliuer and grete of strength
And he had be som tyme in chiuathe
In flaundres in Artois and picarde
